failure_categories_used.QA_EXTRACT: QA model failed to extract correct span
failure_categories_used.QA_CONF: QA model low confidence on correct answer
failure_categories_used.SPURIOUS: Model gave answer when none exists

A0_Production.analysis: A0's primary failure is ABSTAIN (47.6%) - it refuses to answer when it should. EXTRACT failures (40.4%) represent wrong span selection. SPURIOUS (1.6%) are hallucinated answers on unanswerable questions.

A1_DistilBERT.analysis: A1 eliminated ABSTAIN failures (always answers) but this comes at the cost of 42 SPURIOUS answers (hallucinating on ALL unanswerable questions). EXTRACT failures increased dramatically from 371 to 870. ROOT CAUSE: trained with broken span labels (99.3% wrong).

A2_BERT_Base.analysis: A2 has 100% failure rate. Same pattern as A1 - eliminated ABSTAIN but increased EXTRACT and SPURIOUS. ROOT CAUSE: same broken span labels.

A3_DeBERTa_v3.analysis: A3 collapsed entirely - NaN loss from epoch 1 caused model to default to always abstaining. The 4.6% 'non-failure' rate comes from correctly abstaining on 42 unanswerable questions. ROOT CAUSE: NaN training instability.

ABSTAIN.analysis: A0's ABSTAIN failures are a feature of the production model's conservative behavior. A1/A2 eliminated ABSTAIN by always answering (but this caused SPURIOUS). A3's ABSTAIN is from NaN training collapse.

EXTRACT.analysis: A1/A2 have worse EXTRACT than A0 because they were trained with wrong span labels. A3 has 0 EXTRACT because it never extracts anything.

SPURIOUS.analysis: A0 has minimal spurious rate. A1/A2 hallucinate on ALL 42 unanswerable questions because they always answer. A3 correctly abstains on unanswerable (but only because it abstains on everything).

root_cause_classification.description: The run_experiment.py QADataset does not pass return_offsets_mapping=True to the tokenizer, causing the fallback heuristic to use character offsets as token indices. This results in 99.3% of training examples having wrong start/end position labels.
root_cause_classification.secondary_description: All 918 examples were used for both training and evaluation, so metrics measure memorization not generalization.
root_cause_classification.tertiary_description: Production model uses distilbert-base-uncased but A1 was initialized from distilbert-base-cased.
